<?xml version="1.0"?>
<rdf:RDF xml:base="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#"
         xmlns:owl="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#"
         xmlns:rdf="http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#"
         xmlns:rdfs="http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#"
         xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#"
         xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"
         xmlns:vaem="http://www.linkedmodel.org/schema/vaem#">

  <owl:Ontology rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#"/>

  <!-- owl:Class declarations -->

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Tool">
  <rdfs:comment>A computational instrument that utilizes algorithms.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Tool</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ04 supplies tools as the subject of algorithm usage</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which of the named and published algorithms does this tool use?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Algorithm">
  <rdfs:comment>A named and published computational procedure.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Algorithm</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ04 asks which algorithms a tool uses</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which of the named and published algorithms does this tool use?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Modification">
  <rdfs:comment>An alteration or adaptation applied to an algorithm.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Modification</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ05 asks about modifications to algorithms</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ05: Are there any modifications to the algorithm the tool uses?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software">
  <rdfs:comment>A program or application designed to perform computational tasks.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Software</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Central entity across CQ06-CQ17, CQ23-CQ30, CQ37, CQ45, CQ54, CQ58, CQ85</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ06: Does this software provide XML editing?
    (competency_question) CQ07: What type of software (API, Desktop application etc) is it?
    (competency_question) CQ08: What software can perform task x?
    (competency_question) CQ11: Is this software available as a web service?
    (competency_question) CQ16: What software can I use my data with to support my task?
    (competency_question) CQ17: What are the input and output formats for this software?
    (competency_question) CQ19: What software can read a .cel file?
    (competency_question) CQ21: What is the valid input for this software?
    (competency_question) CQ22: Can this software export from its proprietary data format to an open format such as csv, txt?
    (competency_question) CQ23: Can software A work with data that are output from software B?
    (competency_question) CQ26: What open source, maintained software can I use to process these in this format?
    (competency_question) CQ30: Where can I get the software?
    (competency_question) CQ37: What is the homepage of the software?
    (competency_question) CQ45: How long has this software been around?
    (competency_question) CQ54: What is the version of this software?
    (competency_question) CQ58: Is the software open source development? Is there a community development?
    (competency_question) CQ85: What platform does the software run on?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#XmlEditing">
  <rdfs:comment>The capability to parse and modify XML documents.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>XML Editing</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ06 asks if software provides XML editing</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ06: Does this software provide XML editing?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Api">
  <rdfs:comment>Application Programming Interface deployment model.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>API</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ07 lists API as a software type</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ07: What type of software (API, Desktop application etc) is it?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf Software -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#DesktopApplication">
  <rdfs:comment>Software designed to run on local desktop environments.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Desktop Application</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ07 lists desktop application as a software type</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ07: What type of software (API, Desktop application etc) is it?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf Software -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#WebService">
  <rdfs:comment>Software accessible over a network using standard protocols.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Web Service</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ07 and CQ11 identify web services as software/artifacts</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ07: What type of software (API, Desktop application etc) is it?
    (competency_question) CQ11: Is this software available as a web service?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#ComputationalArtifact"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf Software -->
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf ComputationalArtifact -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Task">
  <rdfs:comment>A computational or analytical objective.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Task</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ08 and CQ16 ask about tasks performed or supported</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ08: What software can perform task x?
    (competency_question) CQ16: What software can I use my data with to support my task?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#ComputationalArtifact">
  <rdfs:comment>A digital entity produced by or enabling computation.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Computational Artifact</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ11 places software and web services under this category</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ11: Is this software available as a web service?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#ComputationalArtifact"/>
  <!-- Axiom: Software SubClassOf ComputationalArtifact -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#System">
  <rdfs:comment>A computing environment or platform with functional capabilities.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>System</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ14 and CQ84 refer to systems and their implementations</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ14: Does it do what I want or need it to do e.g. render a gif?
    (competency_question) CQ84: In what language was it implemented?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Capability">
  <rdfs:comment>A functional ability or feature of a system.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Capability</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ14 asks about system capabilities like rendering</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ14: Does it do what I want or need it to do e.g. render a gif?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Gif">
  <rdfs:comment>Graphics Interchange Format image type.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>GIF</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ14 uses GIF rendering as an example capability</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ14: Does it do what I want or need it to do e.g. render a gif?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#SoftwareTool">
  <rdfs:comment>A specialized software instrument used to generate data.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Software Tool</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ15 asks which tool created data</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ15: Which software tool created this data?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Data">
  <rdfs:comment>Digital information processed, created, or exchanged by software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Data</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ15, CQ16, CQ23, CQ26 involve data relationships</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ15: Which software tool created this data?
    (competency_question) CQ16: What software can I use my data with to support my task?
    (competency_question) CQ23: Can software A work with data that are output from software B?
    (competency_question) CQ26: What open source, maintained software can I use to process these in this format?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#InputFormat">
  <rdfs:comment>A file or data structure accepted by software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Input Format</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ17 asks for input formats</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ17: What are the input and output formats for this software?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#OutputFormat">
  <rdfs:comment>A file or data structure produced by software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Output Format</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ17 asks for output formats</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ17: What are the input and output formats for this software?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#CelFile">
  <rdfs:comment>Microarray data file format.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>CEL File</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ19 asks which software reads .cel files</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ19: What software can read a .cel file?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#ValidInput">
  <rdfs:comment>An acceptable input specification for software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Valid Input</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ21 asks for valid inputs</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ21: What is the valid input for this software?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#ProprietaryDataFormat">
  <rdfs:comment>A vendor-specific data encoding scheme.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Proprietary Data Format</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ22 asks about exporting from proprietary formats</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ22: Can this software export from its proprietary data format to an open format such as csv, txt?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#DataFormat">
  <rdfs:comment>A standard data structure like CSV or TXT.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Data Format</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ22 asks about exporting to open formats</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ22: Can this software export from its proprietary data format to an open format such as csv, txt?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Format">
  <rdfs:comment>A general data structure or encoding scheme.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Format</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ26 asks about processing data in a given format</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ26: What open source, maintained software can I use to process these in this format?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Version">
  <rdfs:comment>A specific release iteration of software or input.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Version</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ29 and CQ54 ask about versions</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ29: Given input x, what are the data exports for this version?
    (competency_question) CQ54: What is the version of this software?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Input">
  <rdfs:comment>An entity that can be versioned.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Input</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ29 asks for the version of an input</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ29: Given input x, what are the data exports for this version?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#DataExport">
  <rdfs:comment>Data output generated from a specific version.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Data Export</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ29 asks for data exports of a version</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ29: Given input x, what are the data exports for this version?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#HelpResource">
  <rdfs:comment>Documentation or support channel for users.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Help Resource</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ32 asks how to get help</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ32: How do I get help?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Entity">
  <rdfs:comment>A general digital or conceptual object in the domain.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Entity</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ36, CQ40, CQ46, CQ60, CQ65, CQ68 use Entity as a base class</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ36: Who developed it?
    (competency_question) CQ40: Which URL can I get it from?
    (competency_question) CQ46: How actively developed is it?
    (competency_question) CQ60: Is it open source or not?
    (competency_question) CQ65: Is it FOSS?
    (competency_question) CQ68: Is it free or not?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Developer">
  <rdfs:comment>A person or organization that creates software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Developer</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ36 and CQ38 ask about developers and collaboration</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ36: Who developed it?
    (competency_question) CQ38: Can we collaborate with developers of software x?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Homepage">
  <rdfs:comment>The primary web page for a software project.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Homepage</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ37 asks for the software homepage</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ37: What is the homepage of the software?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Collaboration">
  <rdfs:comment>A cooperative development effort.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Collaboration</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ38 asks about developer collaboration</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ38: Can we collaborate with developers of software x?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Url">
  <rdfs:comment>A web address identifier.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>URL</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ40 asks for the URL of an entity</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ40: Which URL can I get it from?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Feature">
  <rdfs:comment>A functionality added in a software version.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Feature</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ55 asks about new features in a version</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ55: What new features are in this version?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Release">
  <rdfs:comment>A published instance of a software version.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Release</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ57 asks when a version was released</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ57: When was the 1.0 version released?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#OpenSourceDevelopment">
  <rdfs:comment>Software developed using open source practices.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Open Source Development</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ58 asks if software is open source development</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ58: Is the software open source development? Is there a community development?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf Software -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#CommunityDevelopment">
  <rdfs:comment>Development driven by a user or developer community.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Community Development</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ58 asks about community development</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ58: Is the software open source development? Is there a community development?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#License">
  <rdfs:comment>A legal permit governing software usage.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>License</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ59 asks for the license</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ59: What license and what is permissiveness?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Permissiveness">
  <rdfs:comment>The degree of freedom allowed by a license.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Permissiveness</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ59 asks about permissiveness level</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ59: What license and what is permissiveness?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#OpenSourceSoftware">
  <rdfs:comment>Software with accessible and modifiable source code.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Open Source Software</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ60 asks if an entity is open source</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ60: Is it open source or not?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Entity"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf Entity -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#FossSoftware">
  <rdfs:comment>Free and Open Source Software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>FOSS Software</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ65 asks if an entity is FOSS</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ65: Is it FOSS?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Entity"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf Entity -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#FreeSoftware">
  <rdfs:comment>Software that respects user freedom.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Free Software</rdfs:label>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<rdf:RDF xml:base="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#"
         xmlns:owl="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#"
         xmlns:rdf="http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#"
         xmlns:rdfs="http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#"
         xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#"
         xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"
         xmlns:vaem="http://www.linkedmodel.org/schema/vaem#">

  <owl:Ontology rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#"/>

  <!-- owl:Class declarations -->

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Tool">
  <rdfs:comment>A computational instrument that utilizes algorithms.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Tool</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ04 supplies tools as the subject of algorithm usage</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which of the named and published algorithms does this tool use?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Algorithm">
  <rdfs:comment>A named and published computational procedure.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Algorithm</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ04 asks which algorithms a tool uses</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which of the named and published algorithms does this tool use?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Modification">
  <rdfs:comment>An alteration or adaptation applied to an algorithm.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Modification</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ05 asks about modifications to algorithms</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ05: Are there any modifications to the algorithm the tool uses?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software">
  <rdfs:comment>A program or application designed to perform computational tasks.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Software</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Central entity across CQ06-CQ17, CQ23-CQ30, CQ37, CQ45, CQ54, CQ58, CQ85</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ06: Does this software provide XML editing?
    (competency_question) CQ07: What type of software (API, Desktop application etc) is it?
    (competency_question) CQ08: What software can perform task x?
    (competency_question) CQ11: Is this software available as a web service?
    (competency_question) CQ16: What software can I use my data with to support my task?
    (competency_question) CQ17: What are the input and output formats for this software?
    (competency_question) CQ19: What software can read a .cel file?
    (competency_question) CQ21: What is the valid input for this software?
    (competency_question) CQ22: Can this software export from its proprietary data format to an open format such as csv, txt?
    (competency_question) CQ23: Can software A work with data that are output from software B?
    (competency_question) CQ26: What open source, maintained software can I use to process these in this format?
    (competency_question) CQ30: Where can I get the software?
    (competency_question) CQ37: What is the homepage of the software?
    (competency_question) CQ45: How long has this software been around?
    (competency_question) CQ54: What is the version of this software?
    (competency_question) CQ58: Is the software open source development? Is there a community development?
    (competency_question) CQ85: What platform does the software run on?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#XmlEditing">
  <rdfs:comment>The capability to parse and modify XML documents.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>XML Editing</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ06 asks if software provides XML editing</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ06: Does this software provide XML editing?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Api">
  <rdfs:comment>Application Programming Interface deployment model.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>API</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ07 lists API as a software type</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ07: What type of software (API, Desktop application etc) is it?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf Software -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#DesktopApplication">
  <rdfs:comment>Software designed to run on local desktop environments.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Desktop Application</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ07 lists desktop application as a software type</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ07: What type of software (API, Desktop application etc) is it?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf Software -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#WebService">
  <rdfs:comment>Software accessible over a network using standard protocols.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Web Service</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ07 and CQ11 identify web services as software/artifacts</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ07: What type of software (API, Desktop application etc) is it?
    (competency_question) CQ11: Is this software available as a web service?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#ComputationalArtifact"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf Software -->
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf ComputationalArtifact -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Task">
  <rdfs:comment>A computational or analytical objective.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Task</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ08 and CQ16 ask about tasks performed or supported</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ08: What software can perform task x?
    (competency_question) CQ16: What software can I use my data with to support my task?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#ComputationalArtifact">
  <rdfs:comment>A digital entity produced by or enabling computation.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Computational Artifact</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ11 places software and web services under this category</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ11: Is this software available as a web service?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#ComputationalArtifact"/>
  <!-- Axiom: Software SubClassOf ComputationalArtifact -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#System">
  <rdfs:comment>A computing environment or platform with functional capabilities.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>System</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ14 and CQ84 refer to systems and their implementations</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ14: Does it do what I want or need it to do e.g. render a gif?
    (competency_question) CQ84: In what language was it implemented?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Capability">
  <rdfs:comment>A functional ability or feature of a system.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Capability</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ14 asks about system capabilities like rendering</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ14: Does it do what I want or need it to do e.g. render a gif?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Gif">
  <rdfs:comment>Graphics Interchange Format image type.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>GIF</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ14 uses GIF rendering as an example capability</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ14: Does it do what I want or need it to do e.g. render a gif?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#SoftwareTool">
  <rdfs:comment>A specialized software instrument used to generate data.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Software Tool</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ15 asks which tool created data</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ15: Which software tool created this data?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Data">
  <rdfs:comment>Digital information processed, created, or exchanged by software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Data</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ15, CQ16, CQ23, CQ26 involve data relationships</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ15: Which software tool created this data?
    (competency_question) CQ16: What software can I use my data with to support my task?
    (competency_question) CQ23: Can software A work with data that are output from software B?
    (competency_question) CQ26: What open source, maintained software can I use to process these in this format?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#InputFormat">
  <rdfs:comment>A file or data structure accepted by software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Input Format</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ17 asks for input formats</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ17: What are the input and output formats for this software?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#OutputFormat">
  <rdfs:comment>A file or data structure produced by software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Output Format</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ17 asks for output formats</vaem:rationale>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<rdf:RDF xml:base="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#"

         xmlns:vaem="http://www.linkedmodel.org/schema/vaem#">

  <owl:Ontology rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#"/>

  <!-- owl:Class declarations -->

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Tool">
  <rdfs:comment>A computational instrument that utilizes algorithms.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Tool</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ04 supplies tools as the subject of algorithm usage</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which of the named and published algorithms does this tool use?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Algorithm">
  <rdfs:comment>A named and published computational procedure.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Algorithm</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ04 asks which algorithms a tool uses</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which of the named and published algorithms does this tool use?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Modification">
  <rdfs:comment>An alteration or adaptation applied to an algorithm.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Modification</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ05 asks about modifications to algorithms</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ05: Are there any modifications to the algorithm the tool uses?</dc:source>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<rdf:RDF xml:base="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#"

  <owl:Ontology rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#"/>

  <!-- owl:Class declarations -->

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Tool">
  <rdfs:comment>A computational instrument that utilizes algorithms.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Tool</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ04 supplies tools as the subject of algorithm usage</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which of the named and published algorithms does this tool use?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Algorithm">
  <rdfs:comment>A named and published computational procedure.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Algorithm</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ04 asks which algorithms a tool uses</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which of the named and published algorithms does this tool use?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Modification">
  <rdfs:comment>An alteration or adaptation applied to an algorithm.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Modification</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ05 asks about modifications to algorithms</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ05: Are there any modifications to the algorithm the tool uses?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software">

  <rdfs:label>Software</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Central entity across CQ06-CQ17, CQ23-CQ30, CQ37, CQ45, CQ54, CQ58, CQ85</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ06: Does this software provide XML editing?
    (competency_question) CQ07: What type of software (API, Desktop application etc) is it?
    (competency_question) CQ08: What software can perform task x?
    (competency_question) CQ11: Is this software available as a web service?
    (competency_question) CQ16: What software can I use my data with to support my task?
    (competency_question) CQ17: What are the input and output formats for this software?
    (competency_question) CQ19: What software can read a .cel file?
    (competency_question) CQ21: What is the valid input for this software?
    (competency_question) CQ22: Can this software export from its proprietary data format to an open format such as csv, txt?

    (competency_question) CQ26: What open source, maintained software can I use to process these in this format?
    (competency_question) CQ30: Where can I get the software?
    (competency_question) CQ37: What is the homepage of the software?
    (competency_question) CQ45: How long has this software been around?
    (competency_question) CQ54: What is the version of this software?
    (competency_question) CQ58: Is the software open source development? Is there a community development?
    (competency_question) CQ85: What platform does the software run on?</dc:source>

</owl:Class>

  <rdfs:label>CSV</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ22 supplies Csv as an instance</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ22: Can this software export from its proprietary data format to an open format such as csv, txt?</dc:source>
  <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#DataFormat"/>
</owl:NamedIndividual>

<owl:NamedIndividual rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Txt">
  <rdfs:comment>Plain text data format.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>TXT</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ22 supplies Txt as an instance</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ22: Can this software export from its proprietary data format to an open format such as csv, txt?</dc:source>
  <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#DataFormat"/>
</owl:NamedIndividual>

<owl:NamedIndividual rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#SoftwareB">
  <rdfs:comment>A specific software entity.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Software B</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ23 supplies SoftwareB as an instance</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ23: Can software A work with data that are output from software B?</dc:source>
  <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
</owl:NamedIndividual>

<owl:NamedIndividual rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#SoftwareA">
  <rdfs:comment>A specific software entity.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Software A</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ23 supplies SoftwareA as an instance</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ23: Can software A work with data that are output from software B?</dc:source>
  <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
</owl:NamedIndividual>

<owl:NamedIndividual rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#InputX">
  <rdfs:comment>A specific input entity.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Input X</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ29 supplies InputX as an instance</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ29: Given input x, what are the data exports for this version?</dc:source>
  <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Input"/>
</owl:NamedIndividual>

<owl:NamedIndividual rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Version1_0">
  <rdfs:comment>The 1.0 release version.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Version 1.0</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ57 supplies Version1_0 as an instance</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ57: When was the 1.0 version released?</dc:source>
  <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Version"/>
</owl:NamedIndividual>

<owl:NamedIndividual rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#SoftwareX">
  <rdfs:comment>A specific software entity.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Software X</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ38 supplies SoftwareX as an instance</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ38: Can we collaborate with developers of software x?</dc:source>
  <rdf:type rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
</owl:NamedIndividual>

</rdf:RDF>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<rdf:RDF xml:base="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#"
         xmlns:owl="http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#"
         xmlns:rdf="http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#"
         xmlns:rdfs="http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#"
         xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#"
         xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"
         xmlns:vaem="http://www.linkedmodel.org/schema/vaem#">

  <owl:Ontology rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#"/>

  <!-- owl:Class declarations -->

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Tool">
  <rdfs:comment>A computational instrument that utilizes algorithms.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Tool</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ04 supplies tools as the subject of algorithm usage</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which of the named and published algorithms does this tool use?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Algorithm">
  <rdfs:comment>A named and published computational procedure.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Algorithm</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ04 asks which algorithms a tool uses</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which of the named and published algorithms does this tool use?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Modification">
  <rdfs:comment>An alteration or adaptation applied to an algorithm.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Modification</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ05 asks about modifications to algorithms</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ05: Are there any modifications to the algorithm the tool uses?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software">
  <rdfs:comment>A program or application designed to perform computational tasks.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Software</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: Central entity across CQ06-CQ17, CQ23-CQ30, CQ37, CQ45, CQ54, CQ58, CQ85</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ06: Does this software provide XML editing?
    (competency_question) CQ07: What type of software (API, Desktop application etc) is it?
    (competency_question) CQ08: What software can perform task x?
    (competency_question) CQ11: Is this software available as a web service?
    (competency_question) CQ16: What software can I use my data with to support my task?
    (competency_question) CQ17: What are the input and output formats for this software?
    (competency_question) CQ19: What software can read a .cel file?
    (competency_question) CQ21: What is the valid input for this software?
    (competency_question) CQ22: Can this software export from its proprietary data format to an open format such as csv, txt?
    (competency_question) CQ23: Can software A work with data that are output from software B?
    (competency_question) CQ26: What open source, maintained software can I use to process these in this format?
    (competency_question) CQ30: Where can I get the software?
    (competency_question) CQ37: What is the homepage of the software?
    (competency_question) CQ45: How long has this software been around?
    (competency_question) CQ54: What is the version of this software?
    (competency_question) CQ58: Is the software open source development? Is there a community development?
    (competency_question) CQ85: What platform does the software run on?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#XmlEditing">
  <rdfs:comment>The capability to parse and modify XML documents.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>XML Editing</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ06 asks if software provides XML editing</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ06: Does this software provide XML editing?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Api">
  <rdfs:comment>Application Programming Interface deployment model.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>API</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ07 lists API as a software type</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ07: What type of software (API, Desktop application etc) is it?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf Software -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#DesktopApplication">
  <rdfs:comment>Software designed to run on local desktop environments.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Desktop Application</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ07 lists desktop application as a software type</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ07: What type of software (API, Desktop application etc) is it?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf Software -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#WebService">
  <rdfs:comment>Software accessible over a network using standard protocols.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Web Service</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ07 and CQ11 identify web services as software/artifacts</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ07: What type of software (API, Desktop application etc) is it?
    (competency_question) CQ11: Is this software available as a web service?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#ComputationalArtifact"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf Software -->
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf ComputationalArtifact -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Task">
  <rdfs:comment>A computational or analytical objective.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Task</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ08 and CQ16 ask about tasks performed or supported</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ08: What software can perform task x?
    (competency_question) CQ16: What software can I use my data with to support my task?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#ComputationalArtifact">
  <rdfs:comment>A digital entity produced by or enabling computation.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Computational Artifact</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ11 places software and web services under this category</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ11: Is this software available as a web service?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#ComputationalArtifact"/>
  <!-- Axiom: Software SubClassOf ComputationalArtifact -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#System">
  <rdfs:comment>A computing environment or platform with functional capabilities.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>System</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ14 and CQ84 refer to systems and their implementations</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ14: Does it do what I want or need it to do e.g. render a gif?
    (competency_question) CQ84: In what language was it implemented?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Capability">
  <rdfs:comment>A functional ability or feature of a system.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Capability</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ14 asks about system capabilities like rendering</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ14: Does it do what I want or need it to do e.g. render a gif?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Gif">
  <rdfs:comment>Graphics Interchange Format image type.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>GIF</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ14 uses GIF rendering as an example capability</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ14: Does it do what I want or need it to do e.g. render a gif?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#SoftwareTool">
  <rdfs:comment>A specialized software instrument used to generate data.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Software Tool</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ15 asks which tool created data</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ15: Which software tool created this data?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Data">
  <rdfs:comment>Digital information processed, created, or exchanged by software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Data</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ15, CQ16, CQ23, CQ26 involve data relationships</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ15: Which software tool created this data?
    (competency_question) CQ16: What software can I use my data with to support my task?
    (competency_question) CQ23: Can software A work with data that are output from software B?
    (competency_question) CQ26: What open source, maintained software can I use to process these in this format?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#InputFormat">
  <rdfs:comment>A file or data structure accepted by software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Input Format</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ17 asks for input formats</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ17: What are the input and output formats for this software?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#OutputFormat">
  <rdfs:comment>A file or data structure produced by software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Output Format</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ17 asks for output formats</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ17: What are the input and output formats for this software?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#CelFile">
  <rdfs:comment>Microarray data file format.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>CEL File</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ19 asks which software reads .cel files</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ19: What software can read a .cel file?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#ValidInput">
  <rdfs:comment>An acceptable input specification for software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Valid Input</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ21 asks for valid inputs</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ21: What is the valid input for this software?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#ProprietaryDataFormat">
  <rdfs:comment>A vendor-specific data encoding scheme.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Proprietary Data Format</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ22 asks about exporting from proprietary formats</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ22: Can this software export from its proprietary data format to an open format such as csv, txt?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#DataFormat">
  <rdfs:comment>A standard data structure like CSV or TXT.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Data Format</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ22 asks about exporting to open formats</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ22: Can this software export from its proprietary data format to an open format such as csv, txt?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Format">
  <rdfs:comment>A general data structure or encoding scheme.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Format</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ26 asks about processing data in a given format</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ26: What open source, maintained software can I use to process these in this format?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Version">
  <rdfs:comment>A specific release iteration of software or input.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Version</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ29 and CQ54 ask about versions</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ29: Given input x, what are the data exports for this version?
    (competency_question) CQ54: What is the version of this software?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Input">
  <rdfs:comment>An entity that can be versioned.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Input</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ29 asks for the version of an input</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ29: Given input x, what are the data exports for this version?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#DataExport">
  <rdfs:comment>Data output generated from a specific version.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Data Export</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ29 asks for data exports of a version</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ29: Given input x, what are the data exports for this version?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#HelpResource">
  <rdfs:comment>Documentation or support channel for users.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Help Resource</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ32 asks how to get help</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ32: How do I get help?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Entity">
  <rdfs:comment>A general digital or conceptual object in the domain.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Entity</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ36, CQ40, CQ46, CQ60, CQ65, CQ68 use Entity as a base class</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ36: Who developed it?
    (competency_question) CQ40: Which URL can I get it from?
    (competency_question) CQ46: How actively developed is it?
    (competency_question) CQ60: Is it open source or not?
    (competency_question) CQ65: Is it FOSS?
    (competency_question) CQ68: Is it free or not?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Developer">
  <rdfs:comment>A person or organization that creates software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Developer</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ36 and CQ38 ask about developers and collaboration</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ36: Who developed it?
    (competency_question) CQ38: Can we collaborate with developers of software x?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Homepage">
  <rdfs:comment>The primary web page for a software project.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Homepage</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ37 asks for the software homepage</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ37: What is the homepage of the software?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Collaboration">
  <rdfs:comment>A cooperative development effort.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Collaboration</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ38 asks about developer collaboration</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ38: Can we collaborate with developers of software x?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Url">
  <rdfs:comment>A web address identifier.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>URL</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ40 asks for the URL of an entity</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ40: Which URL can I get it from?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Feature">
  <rdfs:comment>A functionality added in a software version.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Feature</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ55 asks about new features in a version</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ55: What new features are in this version?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Release">
  <rdfs:comment>A published instance of a software version.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Release</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ57 asks when a version was released</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ57: When was the 1.0 version released?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#OpenSourceDevelopment">
  <rdfs:comment>Software developed using open source practices.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Open Source Development</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ58 asks if software is open source development</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ58: Is the software open source development? Is there a community development?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Software"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf Software -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#CommunityDevelopment">
  <rdfs:comment>Development driven by a user or developer community.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Community Development</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ58 asks about community development</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ58: Is the software open source development? Is there a community development?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#License">
  <rdfs:comment>A legal permit governing software usage.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>License</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ59 asks for the license</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ59: What license and what is permissiveness?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Permissiveness">
  <rdfs:comment>The degree of freedom allowed by a license.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Permissiveness</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ59 asks about permissiveness level</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ59: What license and what is permissiveness?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#OpenSourceSoftware">
  <rdfs:comment>Software with accessible and modifiable source code.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Open Source Software</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ60 asks if an entity is open source</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ60: Is it open source or not?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Entity"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf Entity -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#FossSoftware">
  <rdfs:comment>Free and Open Source Software.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>FOSS Software</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ65 asks if an entity is FOSS</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ65: Is it FOSS?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#Entity"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf Entity -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/swo#FreeSoftware">
  <rdfs:comment>Software that respects user freedom.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Free Software</rdfs:label>
